en: The Group on Fetters, etc., and the Dyads on Roots.

Dependent on a state that is a fetter and a cause, there arises a state that is neither a fetter nor a cause by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are four; ... [etc. ... under the resultant condition there is one; ... [etc. ... under the non-disappearance condition there are four.

Dependent on a state that is a tie and a cause, there arises a state that is neither a tie nor a cause by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine; ... [etc. ... under the resultant condition there is one; ... [etc. ... under the non-disappearance condition there are nine.
Dependent on a state that is a flood and a cause, there arises a state that is neither a flood nor a cause by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)

Dependent on a state that is both a yoga and a cause, there arises a state that is neither a yoga nor a cause by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are five; ... pe ... under resultant condition there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five.

Dependent on a state that is both a hindrance and a cause, there arises a state that is neither a hindrance nor a cause by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are four; ... under resultant condition there is one; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are four.

Dependent on a state that is not a cause and is not a misconception, there arises a state that is not a cause and is not a misconception, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition, three; under the resultant condition, one; ... up to ... under the non-disappearance condition, three.
